normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- Lake views- Located in WaterColor's desirable Camp District- Short walk to Camp WaterColor pool and green- Sprawling porches- Game room- Outdoor fireplace- 7 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Within WaterColor’s desirable Camp district, 241 Red Cedar Way is a beautiful 7-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom Main House and Carriage House that sleeps up to 14 guests. Enjoy access to the neighborhood amenities, including multiple pools, the illustrious WaterColor Beach Club, and beach access! With a game room and sprawling outdoor living spaces, this lakeside home is perfect for large groups and families looking to unwind on the Emerald Coast.An airy front porch with rocking chairs and fans sets the mood for a peaceful vacation as guests arrive at the 3-level Main House. Head inside to an enormous great room filled with natural light, hardwood floors, and a mix of coastal colors. The sitting area offers 2 soft couches and 2 armchairs and effortlessly melds into the gourmet kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances—including a wine cooler and Wolf stove. A wall-mounted 75” Smart TV is viewable throughout the space for entertainment. Guests can enjoy meals at the round table for 4, the 10-person dining table, or the 5-stool breakfast bar. Outdoor dining is also available on the patio table for 6. On the wraparound back porch, savor lake views while grilling or sinking back on cushioned furniture around the outdoor fireplace. An outdoor shower and laundry room provide convenience after visiting the beach. At the end of the day, guests can retire to the lavish primary bedroom with a king bed and TV.On the second level, there is a luxurious primary bedroom with a king bed and a balcony, alongside 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds.Youthful guests—in age and spirit—will enjoy spending time in the third-level loft, hosting a couch, TV, air hockey table, and 3 twin-over-twin bunk beds.In the comfortable Carriage House, discover an open layout with a queen bed and trundle, kitchenette, TV, sectional, and a private bathroom.An exceptional group getaway awaits at 241 Red Cedar Way in WaterColor. Easily explore with on-site parking—plus 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle! Beach access is available at the WaterColor Beach Club, with secondary access on Goldenrod Circle past the WaterColor Inn. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubSECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR- Bunk Bedroom: Three Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery WaterColor 241 Red Cedar Way Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 7 Beds 16 Sleeps 14 Full Baths 6 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands. - Lake views - Located in WaterColor's desirable Camp District - Short walk to Camp WaterColor pool and green - Sprawling porches - Game room - Outdoor fireplace - 7 adult bikes - 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Within WaterColor’s desirable Camp district, 241 Red Cedar Way is a beautiful 7-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom Main House and Carriage House that sleeps up to 14 guests. Enjoy access to the neighborhood amenities, including multiple pools, the illustrious WaterColor Beach Club, and beach access! With a game room and sprawling outdoor living spaces, this lakeside home is perfect for large groups and families looking to unwind on the Emerald Coast. An airy front porch with rocking chairs and fans sets the mood for a peaceful vacation as guests arrive at the 3-level Main House. Head inside to an enormous great room filled with natural light, hardwood floors, and a mix of coastal colors. The sitting area offers 2 soft couches and 2 armchairs and effortlessly melds into the gourmet kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances—including a wine cooler and Wolf stove. A wall-mounted 75” Smart TV is viewable throughout the space for entertainment. Guests can enjoy meals at the round table for 4, the 10-person dining table, or the 5-stool breakfast bar. Outdoor dining is also available on the patio table for 6. On the wraparound back porch, savor lake views while grilling or sinking back on cushioned furniture around the outdoor fireplace. An outdoor shower and laundry room provide convenience after visiting the beach. At the end of the day, guests can retire to the lavish primary bedroom with a king bed and TV. On the second level, there is a luxurious primary bedroom with a king bed and a balcony, alongside 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds. Youthful guests—in age and spirit—will enjoy spending time in the third-level loft, hosting a couch, TV, air hockey table, and 3 twin-over-twin bunk beds. In the comfortable Carriage House, discover an open layout with a queen bed and trundle, kitchenette, TV, sectional, and a private bathroom. An exceptional group getaway awaits at 241 Red Cedar Way in WaterColor. Easily explore with on-site parking—plus 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle! Beach access is available at the WaterColor Beach Club, with secondary access on Goldenrod Circle past the WaterColor Inn. Book now!
